normalized.title: Lot 2 - Jacket and topsides design
normalized.description: This lot consists of the conceptual design of jacket and topside as part of energy hub concepts (i.e. in a total offshore energy system context). The deliverables foreseen are building blocks of the feasibility study of various offshore structure concepts and their implication for the system design. Examples include feasibility studies into compressor and electrolysis platforms. For compressor platforms this, as an example regards the identification of size/capacity per compressor platform, development and mechanical design, vibration and pulsation studies of centralized compressor platforms, structural analysis and further refinement of the implications of design choices on system cost, scope and the supply chain. For electrolysis platforms this entails the assessment on how different types of electrolysis technologies (e.g. PEM or alkaline) can be realized mechanically/structurally and how they can be integrated in the system (i.e. in relation to the offshore electricity network and the offshore hydrogen network). Furthermore the studies shall aim to assess the spatial impact of such platforms and analyze the implication of various concepts for operating and maintaining such infrastructure as well as technical levers to influence CAPEX and OPEX. Gasunie regards project engineering services as the services needed to execute and partner with Gasunie; to this end regular project status reports, concluding reports and report-outs and support in drafting internal decision-notes (for instance on explored alternatives and the associated evaluation those) are part of the scope of work.

Underkriteriet Pris vurderes på baggrund af priserne, som er angivet af tilbudsgiver i Bilag 2 – Tilbudsliste. Underkriteriet Kvalitet vurderes på baggrund af delkriterie 1 Support, delkriterie 2 Tekniske forudsætninger og delkriterie 3 Funktionalitet og brugervenlighed. Delkriterie 1 vægtes med 10 %, delkriterie 2 vægtes med 50 % og delkriterie 3 vægtes med 40 %.
